# Festivo AI

> AI-powered event planning assistant for weddings, birthdays, college celebrations, and community events.

## Overview

Festivo AI helps you turn an event brief into an editable budget, timeline, vendor checklist, and AI-generated improvement proposals while preserving explicit user approval.

## Features

- **Event Planning**: Create and manage events with comprehensive details at [festivoai01.vercel.app](https://festivoai01.vercel.app)
- **Budget Management**: Decimal-safe budget planning with expense tracking
- **Timeline Generation**: Automated timeline creation and task management
- **Vendor Management**: Vendor checklists, quotes, and booking management
- **AI Suggestions**: Gemini-backed AI planning with human approval workflow
